title: Vectors in action — Earth's orbit and inclination
instructions: Click any body for info. Adjust orbital speed; toggle orbit rings. Notice that Mars's orbit is tilted: its inclination is a vector concept (the orbital plane's normal makes an angle with Earth's).

orbit.central_description: A G-type main-sequence star at the centre of the Solar System. Its gravitational field provides the centripetal force keeping the planets in orbit.

bodies.name: Mercury
bodies.description: Smallest planet; closest to the Sun. Orbital period ≈ 88 days.

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.description: Brightest planet. Atmosphere is mostly CO₂; surface temperature ≈ 460 °C.

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.description: Our home. Take its orbit as the reference plane (inclination 0°).

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.description: The 'Red Planet'. Orbital plane tilted ~1.85° relative to Earth's.
